desc.p: The user creates a geocache they own. The rules are those of the website's "hide a cache" form: the cache is published at once, as Available, or as Temporarily unavailable if date_hidden lies in the future (except for events).
This method is only available on installations that support cache editing. Check the has_cache_editing field in services/apisrv/installation before calling it.

req.name: cache_name
req.p: Name of the geocache. Must not be empty.

req.name: cache_type
req.p: One of the cache types of services/caches/geocache's type field that this installation supports (see cache_types in services/apisrv/installation).

req.name: longitude
req.p: Longitude of the geocache, -180 to 180. 0|0 is refused.

req.name: size2
req.p: Container size, as in the size2 field of services/caches/geocache: none, nano, micro, small, regular, large, xlarge or other.

opt.name: short_description
opt.p: One line shown above the description, plain text.

opt.name: description_format
opt.p: plaintext or html. Plain text is shown as written. HTML is cleaned the same way as on the website (and as log comments in services/logs/submit).

opt.name: desc_lang
opt.p: Language of the description, a two-letter code.

opt.name: country
opt.p: Two-letter country code. Mandatory if the user's profile has no country.

opt.name: date_hidden
opt.p: Date the cache was (or will be) hidden, e.g. 2026-10-20. For events, the event date.

opt.name: passwd
opt.p: Log password: if given, "Found it" log entries need it (see services/caches/edit, which changes it later).

opt.name: alt_wpts
opt.p: JSON array of additional waypoints, each an object with location ("lat|lon"), type (parking, stage, path, final or poi; the aliases physical-stage, virtual-stage and trailhead are accepted) and an optional plain-text description. Names are given by the installation, as in the alt_wpts field of services/caches/geocache.

ul.li: cache_code - code of the new geocache,
url - its page on the website.
